profit_quality.assessment: 2024 reported loss was driven by non-cash fair value and impairment items, but the restaurant business was only marginally profitable. Cash generation is positive, yet a large part is consumed by lease principal, lease interest and store capex.
adjustments: Use 2024 cash basis after leases as the main conservative distributable cash profit: operating cash flow RMB429.945m minus purchases of property, plant, equipment and right-of-use assets RMB110.461m, lease principal RMB217.857m and interest paid RMB22.603m = RMB79.024m.
Cross-check: 2023 equivalent was RMB176.551m and 2022 equivalent was RMB29.725m; the three-year median is close to the 2024 conservative figure.
Do not add back investment property fair value loss or FVTPL fair value loss into distributable cash profit except through operating cash flow, because those are non-operating investment assets.
profit_quality.cashflow_support: Operating cash flow was RMB429.945m in 2024, RMB503.177m in 2023 and RMB299.923m in 2022; after capex, lease principal and interest, cash profit was RMB79.024m, RMB176.551m and RMB29.725m respectively.
profit_quality.haircut_reason: Restaurant profit is volatile and 2024 segment profit was thin; cash flow is real but depends on continued lease payments, store refresh and working capital. A 0.65 haircut is used.

profit_quality.working_capital_assessment: 2024 working capital movements were favorable: receivables decreased and payables increased, partly offset by small inventory increase.
